B. The azimuth of the NCP is your angular distance from the equator.
C. The altitude of the NCP is your angular distance from the equator.

G. The azimuth of the NCP is the same as your longitude.
H. The azimuth of the NCP is your angular distance from the South Pole.
I. The altitude of the NCP is the angular distance from the South Pole.
J. The azimuth of the NCP is the angular distance from the North Pole.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
